Claim: DRIFT-029 (suppress per-unit artifact writes; contradicted PROP-038 §2.1, marker at hybrid_emit.rs:148) and DRIFT-030 (counting the entry-point node clears the aggregator but the root then holds the member twice; marker at bootgen.rs:89) both stopped for a ruling.

Claim: one rule at compose time — a static entry that would embed a with_static package's unit artifact is elided to a provenance stub if every boot-bearing member of its zone is already present as its own static entry; coverage is never lost.
crates/vibe-workspace/src/install/bootgen.rs:147,154-169 (desubstitute_covered_units)

desubstitute_covered_units at bootgen.rs:147 implements exactly this: roll a substituted entry back, or elide a contentless umbrella to a stub, IF every zone member is present individually; :161 «a lane emits each package's text once, but never at the cost of losing coverage (PROP-038 §2.1)».
BOSS: `desubstitute_covered_units` exists in `crates/vibe-workspace/src/install/bootgen.rs` and is the compose-time pass the fact describes.

Claim: the hoist route (count entry-points as pullers in soft_static_pulls) degrades the aggregator but causes a root double-write (closure walk + append_hoisted) and a world-wide blast radius; the narrow fix is the composition rule.
crates/vibe-workspace/src/install/bootgen.rs:76 (soft_static_pulls), :137 (append_hoisted), :118-135 (DRIFT-030 root double-write analysis)

soft_static_pulls at :76, append_hoisted at :137; the DRIFT-030 marker :118-135 records the measured root double-write («the root then holds the member twice, once per path») — the trap the design rejects the hoist route for.

Claim: dropping the substitution unconditionally silently changes the semantics of a static edge to a zone whose members resolve dynamic at node level; PROP-038 §2.2 recursion. The conditional elision preserves §2.2.
spec/modules/vibe-workspace/PROP-038-hybrid-boot-linking.md (§2.2); bootgen.rs:154-169

PROP-038 §2.2 is the static-edge recursion contract (the design's reference); desubstitute_covered_units is conditional (bootgen.rs:159 «IF every boot-bearing member … is already present») — coverage-preserving, not an unconditional drop.

Claim: owner's two hardening probes (2026-08-04) — mixed consumers, and own-code + shared libs; the verdict is order- and mix-independent (pure function of the entry set); de-substitution reverts a snippet-bearing aggregator to its own snippet.
